entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-27
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JsonSourceGenerationOptionsAttribute constructor is out of sync with the JsonSerializerOptions constructor #122757
  • Info warnings noise produced by LibraryImport generator #122755
  • Many dimensions with `http.client.open_connections` #122752
  • `NetworkInterface.GetAllNetworkInterfaces()` different behaviour in .net 9 / 10 comapred to .net 8 and earlier #122751

Closed

  • [RuntimeAsync] 6 TODOs in dllimport.cpp #121758
    11.0.0
  • `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` when creating FrozenDictionary or FrozenSet with very large strings #121673
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix SYSLIB1092 in corelib #122756
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, community-contribution
  • Handle shared generics for byref struct in UnsafeAccessors #122754
    community-contribution, needs-area-label

Merged

  • Refactor lock upgrade logic #122571
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Fix debug build #122753
    area-System.Threading, community-contribution
  • Resolve dllimport.cpp runtimeasync todos #122466
    area-Interop-coreclr, runtime-async

Updated

  • System.IO.Ports: check device capabilities for DTR/DSR in SerialStream Constructor/dispose (Windows) #122454
    community-contribution, area-System.IO.Ports
  • Add GroupJoin overload returning IGrouping<TOuter, TInner> #121999
  • Add Join/LeftJoin/RightJoin tuple overloads to LINQ APIs #121998
  • [WIP] [Draft] runtime-async Exception.ToString() #122722
    area-ExceptionHandling-coreclr, runtime-async
  • Move stgpool to md subsystem, extract memory streams, eliminate VM dependencies on MD internals #122723
    area-VM-coreclr
  • Add SearchValues<string> specialization for two equal-length strings #122749
    area-System.Runtime
  • [System.Net.Sockets.Tests] Make UDP SendTo implicit-bind and AccessDenied tests deterministic on mobile/restricted environments #122556
    area-System.Net.Sockets, os-android, community-contribution
